description: Bilateral Air Services Negotiations between  Sri Lanka and South Africa
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-08-08
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. Piyankara Jayaratne, Minister of Civil Aviation, to enter into an Air Services Agreement between Sri Lanka and the Republic of South Africa as a means of creating and preserving friendship, understanding and cooperation between the two countries, was approved by the Cabinet.
